Civil Engineering
Resilient buildings and bridges. Safer roads. Sustainable materials. Innovative construction. Clean drinking water. Every aspect of the Iowa State University Department of Civil, Construction and Environmental Engineering is focused on a better quality of life for Iowa, our nation and our world.
Program Homepage
Collaborate closely with distinguished faculty on cutting-edge studies in infrastructure resilience, smart cities, sustainable construction practices, and environmental impact assessment. Gain practical experience through hands-on projects, fieldwork, and internships with industry leaders. Whether your goals involve designing resilient bridges, improving urban transportation systems, or enhancing environmental sustainability, Iowa State equips you with the knowledge and skills to innovate and address global infrastructure challenges.
Degrees Offered:
Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)
Master of Engineering (M.Engr.)
Master of Science (M.S.)
Online Master of Engineering (M.Engr.)
Online Master of Science (M.S.)
Area(s) of Specialization: (may appear on ISU transcripts after graduation)
Civil Engineering Materials (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
Construction Engineering and Management (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
Environmental Engineering (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
Geotechnical Engineering (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
Transdisciplinary Infrastructure Engineering (M.S., Ph.D.)
Structural Engineering (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
Transportation Engineering (M.Engr., M.S., Ph.D.)
How long does it take to earn a degree?
Median time to earn the doctorate: 4.0 years (Methods)
Median time to earn the master’s: 1.8 years (Methods)

Admission Requirements
Graduate College Requirements:
4 year Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent)
Academic Records/Transcripts
Minimum 3.0 GPA (Program may alter requirement.)
Proof of English Proficiency.
Program Specific Requirements:
Required documents: Unofficial transcripts from all institutions attended, Statement of Purpose, Resume/CV, 3 LOR’s, English proficiency (international students). Upload all documents to application, do not send to department.
Assistantship consideration for MS/thesis and PHD. MEng is not considered. Indicate on application checkboxes consideration for RA, TA or both.
GRE is preferred but not required.
Online program includes Civil Engineering with program focus of Construction Engineering and Management.
The International Collaborative Education Program (ICEP) is intended for participating institutions that have an agreement with the College of Engineering. For additional information, please click here.
Program Requires GRE: No
Program Requires GMAT: No
Program Will Review Without TOEFL or IELTS: No

Application Requirements
Application Deadlines:
First consideration for assistantship: Dec.15 for the following Fall (August) start. August 1 for following Spring (January) start. Only complete applications will be considered (see required docs). Applications for Master of Engineering or any self-funded or sponsored applicants for MS or PHD are considered on a rolling basis.
Application Details:
This program is open to domestic and international students.
